answer: In a Proof of Agent economy, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing prevents Sybil attacks through topological cut verifications and stake slashing. When an isolated cluster forms a quiet lagoon in the trust graph, cross-auditing committees evaluate its bottleneck cuts. Malicious identity flooding fails because slashing drives the attacker's capital to its nadir; branching like a willow requires superlinear attacker stake as cut capacity scales.
